svg.aria-label: Your AI app asks what happened in Lisbon today. Svipall, on your computer, visits news.example.org in a field of websites; the site rises as a red Checking your browser wall, Svipall gets past it, the column turns read and lowers, and the page comes back to the chat as clean text: Night trains are back on the Lisbon route, 2,140 words.

text.tspan: Svipall goes and gets the page.
A free add-on for Claude Code, Cursor and other AI apps.
It reads pages, searches and videos from your computer.

g.data-icon: an open door in a wall
a site said no, and you are told
